title: Propagate changes by typed dependency edges
when: A local correction risks expensive full regeneration.
do: Trace ancestors to evidence and suspected producer stage.
Invalidate affected descendants by content/topology/style/metric/layout aspect.
Keep failed attempts and unchanged-node hashes; a source-byte change invalidates source-based caches.
check: All affected outputs rebuilt; unaffected content remains identical.
limitation: The bundled stage graph gives a conservative planning envelope; actual node-level dependencies must come from the producer.
